entities.name: Rose-Adélaïde Ducreux
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Rose-Adélaïde Ducreux was a French painter and musician, born in Paris. She was the eldest daughter of Joseph Ducreux, with whom she also studied. She showed her works at the Louvre salons in 1791, 1793, 1795, 1798, and 1799. She was accomplished both as a performer and as a composer.
